name: Knott's Casa California Restaurante (Fiesta Village) Grilled Pollo Asado or Carne Asada Rice Bowl (Plain Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Casa California Restaurante (Fiesta Village · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Casa California operates like a Chipotle-style build-your-own line inside Fiesta Village—letting you build a custom bowl or flour-tortilla burrito with strictly white cilantro-free/mild rice, grilled chicken or steak, shredded Monterey Jack cheese, and guacamole!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the server for a Bowl or Burrito with **Rice, Grilled Chicken (or Steak), Shredded Cheese, and Guacamole ONLY**—no black/pinto beans, no fajita peppers/onions, no corn salsa, no spicy red/green salsa, and no lime squeeze.
watchOuts: Skip whole black/pinto beans, corn salsa, raw pico de gallo, and spicy salsas
